name: Redmi Note 4

images.credit: Riski394, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: GSM: 850/900/1800/1900, HSPA: 850 / 900 / 1900 / 2100, LTE: B3, B5, B40 (India Qualcomm), LTE Cat.6 2CA(50 mbps uplink, 300 mbps downlink)

Body.Dimensions: 151 mm H, 76 mm W, 8.45 mm D

Platform.Operating system: Redmi Note 4: MIUI 10.0 based on Android 6.0, Redmi Note 4 (SD)/4X: MIUI 11.0 based on Android 7.0.
Platform.CPU: MediaTek Helio X20 Deca core (TSMC 20nm HKMG) Max. 2.1GHz (2x 2.1 GHz Cortex A72 + 4x 1.85 GHz Cortex A53 + 4x 1.4 GHz Cortex A53) MT6796, or, Qualcomm Snapdragon 625 Octa core (14nm Samsung LPP FinFET) Max. 2.0 GHz (8x 2.0 GHz Cortex-A53) MSM8953
Platform.GPU: Redmi Note 4: Mali-T880 MP4 (28nm process) 780MHz, Redmi Note 4 (SD)/4X: Adreno 506 (14nm process) 650MHz

Memory.RAM: 16 GB, 32 GB or 64 GB eMMC 5.1, RAM:, 2 GB, 3 GB or 4 GB LPDDR3 32-bit Single-Channel 933MHz
Memory.Card slot: microSD, up to 128 GB (uses SIM 2 slot)

Display.Display: 5.5 in IPS LCD capacitive touchscreen, 1080 x 1920 pixels, ~401 ppi, 16M colors with 2.5D scratch resistant curved glass., Vendors: BOE, Tianma, EBBG (Late 2017 units onwards)

Cameras.Rear camera: 13 MP, Sony Exmor RS IMX258, or , Samsung ISOCELL S5K3L8, or , Omnivision Purecel OV18355, All sensors have: f/2.0, 0.1s ultra fast phase detection autofocus (PDAF), 1.12μm pixel size, CMOS BSI with dual-LED (dual tone) flash, 5-piece lens, 4K/4K UHD, 120fps slo-mo support.
Cameras.Front camera: 5 MP Samsung ISOCELL S5K5E8 f/2.0, 1080p, face recognition support

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac* Dual Band 2.4/5.0 GHz, Wi-Fi Direct, hotspot, Bluetooth 4.1, A2DP, LE, (* = Wi-Fi 802.11 ac band supported on MTK variant only)
